abstraction_design.rationale: The abstractions that carry real variation (Card, PokemonCards, MoveTable, Section) stretch well and stay flag-light; the duplication left per-route is small, though there's no shared helper for 'select synced to URL' or alphabetical link lists.

findings.issue: Uncontrolled inputs synced to the URL via refs plus two hand-rolled effects (including pre-hydration compensation), duplicated in a second variant in app/app/routes/pokemon.tsx:202-216; behavior changes require coordinated edits and bugs get fixed twice.
findings.suggestion: Extract a small hook (e.g. useUrlSyncedControl) or switch to controlled inputs driven from the URL, and share it between the home filters and the game picker.

findings.issue: The catch-all route renders null and throws a 404 that bubbles to root, while the actual Not-found markup lives in app/app/root.tsx:66-73; the 404 UI is split across two files.
findings.suggestion: Render the Not found UI from the catch-all route's own component (or export it from a shared component module) so the route file owns its page.

findings.issue: CoverageRelation duplicates the DamageRelations shape already defined in lib/api.server.ts, and routes/team.tsx:19-28 hand-maps one into the other.
findings.suggestion: Have the team loader pass index.damageRelations directly (or type CoverageRelation as DamageRelation) and delete the mapping.

findings.issue: Sprite URLs are built from a hardcoded path pattern instead of the API-provided front_default, so a divergence in the API's media layout silently breaks every card.
findings.suggestion: At minimum keep it in this one function (it already is); better, source front_default from the per-Pokémon data when the index is built.

findings.issue: The generic Card type carries `hidden`, an ability-page-only concern, baked into PokemonCards.tsx:25; removing abilities leaves dead type field and markup.
findings.suggestion: Render the hidden-ability note via the existing `action` slot (or a per-list extension) instead of a field on the shared DTO.

findings.issue: pokemonCards' `extra` callback parameter is used only by ability.tsx — speculative generality that turns into dead code if abilities are removed.
findings.suggestion: Either use it for the team list too, or inline the hidden flag handling at the one call site and drop the parameter.

findings.issue: Filter controls are inlined with no reusable control component, so adding a control (e.g. a sort selector shared with other card lists) means copying markup and wiring.
findings.suggestion: Extract the labeled-field markup into a small component used by all filter controls.

summary: A well-layered app where every card list, sprite URL and data-source detail funnels through single seams in lib/api.server.ts, and presentational components stay free of data knowledge. The main editability cost is the hand-rolled, duplicated URL-synced-control pattern in home.tsx and pokemon.tsx, plus a few pieces of feature residue (Card.hidden, the extra callback, the split 404 UI). Changes land in one obvious place more often than not.
